title: Claude Code: 2026 Feature Updates
content:
## Overview

Claude Code received a wave of major capability additions throughout early-to-mid 2026. This page covers the most significant changes: new interactive features, model upgrades, agentic primitives, and platform expansions. For foundational Claude Code concepts, see the [Claude Code Overview](claude-code-overview) page.

---

## Agent View (Week 20, May 2026)

Agent View opens a **persistent session dashboard** — one screen per active Claude Code session — showing:
- What's currently running
- What's blocked waiting for your input
- What's completed

This replaces scrolling through terminal output to track parallel or long-running tasks. Agent View is especially useful when using Claude Code's Dispatch feature to run multiple background sessions simultaneously.

---

## /goal Command

The `/goal` command tells Claude to **keep working across turns until a specified completion condition holds**, rather than stopping after each response.

Example:
```
/goal All TypeScript errors in src/ are resolved and `npm run build` exits 0
```

Claude will iterate — reading errors, editing files, re-running the build — until the condition is met or it determines the goal is unachievable. This is distinct from a single long response: the loop can span many turns and survive context compression.

---

## Fast Mode: Upgraded to Opus 4.7

Fast mode (toggled with `/fast`) now uses **Claude Opus 4.7** by default, upgraded from Opus 4.6. This brings the 87.6% SWE-Bench Verified performance and 3× vision resolution into the fast-output mode. Fast mode uses a premium pricing tier for faster token generation.

---

## Context Compression: "Summarize up to here"

The Rewind menu now includes a **"Summarize up to here"** option. Selecting a point in the conversation compresses all context before that point into a compact summary, freeing context window space without losing the key facts from earlier in the session. This is particularly useful in long coding sessions where early file reads and tool results would otherwise crowd out current work.

---

## Q1 2026: Major Capability Additions

### Remote Control
Allows Claude Code to receive instructions from a remote process — enabling headless automation, CI/CD pipelines, and programmatic multi-agent coordination without a human in the loop.

### Dispatch
Dispatch is the Claude Code CLI's native multi-agent primitive. You can spawn background Claude Code sessions from within a session (or from a script), with each session targeting a specific directory, model, settings file, and MCP config:

```bash
claude agents \
  --add-dir ./src/auth \
  --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 \
  --mcp-config .claude/mcp-lightweight.json \
  "Fix all TypeScript type errors in the auth module"
```

Key new flags added in 2026:
- `--add-dir` — add a directory to the agent's file access scope
- `--settings` — use a specific settings file
- `--mcp-config` — use a specific MCP config
- `--plugin-dir` — load plugins from a directory
- `--permission-mode` — set permission level for the session
- `--model` — override the model
- `--effort` — set the thinking effort level
- `--dangerously-skip-permissions` — skip permission prompts (use with care in trusted CI environments)

### Channels
Channels provide a structured message-passing layer between concurrent Claude Code sessions — allowing a coordinator session to broadcast tasks and receive structured results from workers.

### Computer Use in Claude Code
Claude Code can now interact with **native desktop applications** directly from the terminal: opening apps, clicking through UI elements, filling forms, and verifying visual changes. This is backed by the OSWorld-capable computer use model (Opus 4.7 at 78% OSWorld-Verified).

### AutoDream
A Claude Code-specific integration with the Managed Agents Dreaming feature: sessions can opt into a background review process that consolidates learnings about a specific codebase into the agent's long-term memory, improving performance on repeated tasks in the same repo.

---

## Desktop App: General Availability

Claude Code on Desktop is **generally available** on all paid plans for both macOS and Windows as of early 2026. The desktop app provides native OS integration, improved performance outside the browser, and persistent local settings.

---

## Rate Limit Increases

API rate limits for Claude Code were **doubled** in early 2026 to support developers, startups, and enterprises building production-scale agentic workflows.

---

## Reliability and Workflow Improvements

A broad reliability update in May 2026 included:
- Better background session handling
- Improved model and plugin management
- Faster MCP and SDK startup times
- JSON session listing (`claude sessions --json`)
- Richer plugin discovery
- Improved status and suggestion UX
- Better tracing and hooks instrumentation
